mapper.sql: id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, user_type, tenant_id, dept_id, enabled, account_non_expired, account_non_locked, credentials_non_expired, create_time, last_login_time, last_login_ip, avatar
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, nickname, email, phone, user_type, tenant_id, dept_id, enabled, account_non_expired, account_non_locked, credentials_non_expired, avatar) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{userType}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{enabled}, #{accountNonExpired}, #{accountNonLocked}, #{credentialsNonExpired}, #{avatar})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, user_type = #{userType}, dept_id = #{deptId}, avatar = #{avatar} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
